text: The decider for the hardest cells runs ten long searches per text. If a hidden message is usually found in the first runs, or in short ones, it can be cut.
259 texts (37 planted messages, clean and Sanborn-style, and 6 scrambled copies of each) climbed twice, every run's best written down.

At length 23 one full run finds as many as ten; at 13 nothing under nine does. With copies climbed one at a time, 3.5 times cheaper, short of ten. The ten-run power itself came out lower than recorded: messy 6 of 12 at 23, clean 2 of 5 at 13.
